statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and dizziness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
The service is to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
